title: Optimal Indocyanine Green Dosage for Repetitive Angiography for Laparoscopic Colorectal Surgery.
summary: Prospective experimental study in 15 colorectal surgery patients used ML clustering of NIR fluorescence perfusion patterns across ICG dose groups. The 0.01 mg/kg group had lower analysis accessibility and adequate-pattern rate than groups 2–5; conventional dose measures were favorable.
ai_technology: §2 and §3.2: ML clustering classifies fluorescence perfusion traces as adequate/inadequate alongside quantitative time/intensity metrics.
